_about: Porting vectors for yubikey-fleet/bin/yk-batch-secrets.py (git HEAD of that repo). ALL master keys and serials are SYNTHETIC. derive() values were produced by the reference module AND an independent spec re-implementation; both agree.

algorithm.ikm: master key FILE BYTES with leading/trailing ASCII whitespace stripped (Python bytes.strip()); no hex/base64 decoding; must be >= 32 bytes
algorithm.okm: block_1 || block_2 || ... (NOT RFC5869: no Extract, no T(i-1) chaining)
algorithm.sampling: limit = floor(256/|A|)*|A|; for each okm byte b in order: if b < limit emit A[b % |A|]; stop at length; if okm exhausted first -> hard error (no extra blocks)

construction_checks.check: block1 == full HKDF (Extract salt=zeros, then Expand)

masters.note: 44 ASCII bytes + trailing LF in file; LF stripped
file holds 64 ASCII hex chars; used AS TEXT (64-byte key), NOT hex-decoded
64 raw bytes = HMAC block size (not pre-hashed)
32 ASCII bytes wrapped in space/tab/CR/LF; bytes.strip() removes them
105 bytes > HMAC block size: HMAC pre-hashes the key (standard HMAC)
